title: Worst-case wait is 360s per vision call and timed-out fetches are never aborted
detail: chain.ts gives each of 3 backends a 120s withTimeout (Promise.race, no AbortSignal; apps/api realTransport fetch has no timeout). Worst case per frame = 2x120s ollama + 120s gemini = 360s, multiplied by frames (and again for keyframe OCR), with abandoned sockets left open.
fix_direction: Lower per-backend default (e.g. 45s) and a per-call total budget; pass AbortSignal through Transport.

title: Live: glm-5.3-flash (first in chain) returned reasoning prose, not JSON; every frame pays a wasted call
detail: Live smoke on frame230.jpg: glm-5.3-flash reply began 'The user w...' and failed JSON.parse; deepseek-v4.1-flash then served in 10.9s total. think:false/format:json did not make glm comply. Also the JSON.parse SyntaxError text puts the first ~10 chars of the model reply into tally.failures and the log.
fix_direction: Reorder or fix glm request (strip reasoning, tolerate fenced JSON), or demote it; use a fixed error message instead of the raw SyntaxError.
